Input image 1 is the authoritative EXISTING MAP layout and style reference. Focus on and enlarge ONLY the southeast courtyard district marked by the three overlapping red rectangles: the existing tree garden in the upper part, the large paved empty area south of the small book/chess kiosk and east of the laundry/bath building, and the open pocket immediately south of the long warehouse. Render a clean, detailed close-up of this whole connected district including narrow contextual edges of the laundry on the left, the small kiosk at upper left, warehouse at right, and closed stone perimeter wall across the bottom. Remove all editor chrome, red rectangles, colored interaction dots and selection marks. 
Very important geometry invariants: keep the existing tall tree and small stone garden monument in the upper middle, keep the small kiosk upper-left of it, the laundry building left of the big empty yard, and the long warehouse on the right. Keep their building footprints, door locations and adjoining paths. The southern perimeter remains a continuous closed wall, with no invented exterior exits. Leave a broad, visibly walkable north-south path from the kiosk/tree area through the south yard and a continuous broad east-west path just inside the southern wall, connecting laundry to warehouse/logistics. Keep all entry thresholds clear. Make this a practical inhabited old prison/factory campus.
Style: match the attached Godot game's polished orthographic 2D painted sprite art, mildly visible front faces on objects, warm grey-green paving, weathered pale stone coping, desaturated olive plants, rusty blue steel and honey-brown wood, small worn joints, consistent scale and subtle short shadows. Straight orthographic overhead camera, no tilted isometric geometry or perspective panorama. Ground details stay low; stone-edged soil/grass transitions. No giant tower, no full roof covering the courtyard, no glossy resort finish. Moderate readable prop density, not clutter. All proposed objects must read clearly at actual game scale. Add 3-4 small orange-uniform prisoners and 1 navy guard at realistic sprite scale, spaced on clear paths.
Output one landscape final concept image, approximately 3:2, consistent framing between variants. Provide a restrained cream caption band along the bottom OUTSIDE the rendered map for the variant title only. Do not put lots of explanatory labels on the map.

The southeast pocket south of warehouse becomes a modest square planted garden with a single small shade tree, a bench and lamp; keep ample path between this garden and perimeter wall. It feels like supervised worker/prisoner rest, modest and orderly, not ornamental luxury. No water fountain or large sports field. Keep the lower through-road visibly connected.
